title: Sources: Amazon's ZeroOne team is developing "Transformer", a phone that syncs up with Alexa; it would be Amazon's first smartphone since its 2014 Fire Phone (Greg Bensinger/Reuters)
summary: Greg Bensinger / Reuters: Sources: Amazon's ZeroOne team is developing “Transformer”, a phone that syncs up with Alexa; it would be Amazon's first smartphone since its 2014 Fire Phone — In 2014, Amazon (AMZN.O) introduced its first smartphone, hoping to take on Apple and Samsung.
